title: Enforce per-event calendar/participant/date limits with invalidProperties
description: c5c9bb0 (#449): CalendarEvent create/update MUST fail with invalidProperties when calendarIds or participants exceed maxCalendarsPerEvent/maxParticipantsPerEvent, or any date is outside minDateTime/maxDateTime; floating LocalDateTime compared as if UTC. Not implemented: backend.rs:1124-1127 says the limits are 'not yet enforced'; min/maxDateTime never checked. Add to CalendarsLimits, check in the /set handler after patching, name offending properties, test each limit.
close_reason: CalendarEvent/set enforces maxCalendarsPerEvent, maxParticipantsPerEvent, minDateTime/maxDateTime (-34); CalendarsLimits docs list backend-left cases; snapshot blessed. main: a3d0c269
